newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui meets with Dalai Lama.
Dalai Lama says he hopes for "one country, two systems" solution to dispute between communist China and Tibet.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee discusses spiritual reforms with Dalai Lama.
Thirty nine dead in California mass suicide.
LIBERTY TIMES - Military transport frigate collides with South Korean tanker; no one hurt.
Train derails, killing one and injuring 20.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to nationalise two local banks.
Economic indicator sees rise in February.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - International information and telecommunication agreement to take effect in July.
Dow Jones to include seven stocks in Taiwan index in April.
